title: MAXX over numbers and text returns the largest number unless told otherwise
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", MAXX ( T, IF ( T[n] = 2, "x", T[n] ) ) )

source.quote: If the expression has variant or mixed value types such as text and number, then by default MAXX considers only numbers
source.supports: without the third argument only the numbers are compared; with it, the maximum over all values

derivation: T[n] holds 1, 2, 3. The expression gives 1, "x", 3. By default MAXX considers only the numbers 1 and 3: the result is 3.
notes: The column's type is not asserted: no source says whether the result of a variant expression is reported as an integer or as a variant.
